answer: Insurance staking gives an identity weight only after it locks 50 units for 60 days, and the stake is forfeited if a jury finds copied work. To activate a stake, one operator must solve a cipher issued only to that identity within 10 minutes, cross a 20-meter ledge carrying the solution, and wait at the far end until a comet is timed crossing a fixed sky marker. A reused cipher, a ledge crossing under 30 seconds, or two identities recording the same comet time voids both stakes, so 100 fakes need 100 separate locks, solutions, and crossings.
